title: Resource-gated Qwen3-1.7B INDEX_m capability and direct-message pilot
research_question: Can a locally cached small instruction model reliably read and answer INDEX_m in the full-information condition, then transfer a vector through a role-separated message without the receiver seeing the sender's private input?
scope: A small capability and direct-message feasibility screen. The structured JSON wire form is an existing baseline, not a proposed new language. The pilot cannot establish superiority, generalization, or a scaling law.

task_shard.selection_rule: Use episode indices 0 and 1 at each of m=4 and m=8 from the pinned v0.2 manifest; no selection by outcome.

model.name: Qwen3-1.7B
model.runtime: repository local_chat_server.py, one local worker, one PyTorch/OMP/MKL CPU thread, BelowNormal process priority

full_information_gate.agent_view: One model call sees the complete bit vector and receiver index.
full_information_gate.success: Strict JSON object {"bit":0} or {"bit":1} exactly matches the gold bit.
full_information_gate.gate: All four episodes must be correct and non-truncated before any communication-condition model call is made.

one_way_structured_message.receiver_view: Only the 1-based index and the exact raw sender output.
one_way_structured_message.wire_format_requested: JSON object {"bits":"0101..."}; no shared prompt contains the hidden vector or gold bit.
one_way_structured_message.success: The receiver's strict JSON bit answer equals the evaluator's gold bit. Invalid sender JSON is still passed verbatim to the receiver and counts in end-to-end success.

resource_safeguards.launch_gate: Three host CPU samples at 2-second intervals must average below 20% and each remain below 30%; NVIDIA GPU utilization below 25%; GPU memory below 1800 MiB; free system memory at least 6000 MiB; port 8001 unused.
resource_safeguards.automatic_stop: Stop this runner and only its own local service after host CPU reaches 45% or GPU utilization reaches 85% in two consecutive 10-second samples, free system memory drops below 4000 MiB, or the 300-second cap is reached.
resource_safeguards.cleanup: A PowerShell finally block terminates and waits for only the child runner and model-server processes launched by this experiment.
resource_safeguards.network: Model and tokenizer load local-only; endpoint binds to 127.0.0.1; no external API or network call is permitted.

metrics: strict JSON adherence and decode failure
message UTF-8 bytes and standalone recipient tokenizer tokens
per-call input/output tokens, request time, and generation time
host CPU, server CPU, server working set, GPU utilization/memory, and free RAM telemetry
interpretation_limits: Four selected episodes are an operating-point screen, not a stable success-rate estimate.
Passing the full-information gate only licenses this tiny direct-message feasibility observation.
The JSON vector is an established structured baseline; this experiment does not propose a new language or compare representations.
The one-way ASCII JSON vector is not bit-optimal and its bytes/tokens are not comparable to the theoretical m-bit lower bound without encoding costs.
One model revision and one task family do not establish transfer, cross-model compatibility, semantic generality, robustness, or scaling.
raw_data: .cache/index_v0_3/; publish only sanitized records and outcomes
